## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow `type(scope): short description` (`feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `test`, `docs`, `chore`)
- [ ] `cd frontend && npm test` passes
- [ ] `cd frontend && npm run lint` passes
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] API changes validate their inputs and return appropriate status codes
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or connection strings in the diff
- [ ] Docs updated if behavior or setup changed
